                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_isrc_total_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_smd_total_exp
             FROM
                     prev_business_date prev
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
                                ON prev.business_date = child.business_date
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
                                ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
                                ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
                                ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id 
                                    AND UPPER(pos.PRODUCT_TYPE) <> 'NETTING'
             WHERE
                 parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                 OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                 OR EXISTS
                 (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                     WHERE
                       parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
					   and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                 )
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 parent.party_name,
                 parent.rtg_final
         ),
     child_level_exp_limits AS
         (
             SELECT
                 parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
                 child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_cash_pb_exp,
                 MAX(child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.repo_fi_limit) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS der_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_fi_limit) AS der_smd_threshold,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-03' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                             (
                                 SELECT 1
                                 FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                 WHERE
                                     parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
									 and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                     AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                     AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                             )
                  )
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 child.cppib_party_id
         ),
     breaches_under_parents AS
         (
             SELECT
                 cppib_party_id,
                 MIN(status) AS status
             FROM
                 (
                     SELECT
                         cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
                         CASE
                             WHEN total_cash_pb_exp >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit OR total_der_repo_sbl_exp >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit OR isrc_total_exp >= isrc_total_limit OR smd_total_exp >= smd_total_limit THEN 'BREACH'
                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits
                 ) p
             GROUP BY cppib_party_id
         )
SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,

    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 10000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,
    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 19:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,

                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *

            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit))

      business_date,
      security_identifier,

SELECT

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM

		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 20:16:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

with hedge_ratio_src as (
	select case
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0 then f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy = 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy != 0 then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy else f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
		end hedge_pv,
		coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * coalesce(dpi.local_currency_fcp, 0) as fcp_base,
		dpi.long_short,
		h.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	from risk_prod.dim_pos_inst dpi
		join risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd f on f.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
		and dpi.business_date = f.business_date
		join risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id
		and dpi.business_date = h.business_date
		left join risk_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
		and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
	where dpi.business_date = '2025-06-03'
		and dpi.portfolio_Type = 'IP'
		and (
			dpi.maturity_date is null
			or to_date(dpi.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= dpi.maturity_date
		)
		 AND  h.investment_strat in ('Asia')
		 and not (  dpi.cppib_product_type in ('Common Stock Private', 'Preferred Stock') OR dpi.security_group_name in ('Call Money Funding Services', 'Cash Bucket', 'Cost', 'Internal Funding Source and Loans', 'FX Non Deliverable Forward', 'FX Forward', 'Pooled Fund Private Equity', 'Private Debt Direct', 'Private Equity Direct'))
),
hedge_ratio_short_long as (
	select sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'LONG' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as long_hedge_pv,
		sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'SHORT' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as short_hedge_pv,
		sum(fcp_base) fcp_base_pv,
		'Y' subtruct_fcp
	from hedge_ratio_src a
)
select 'AE_FEA_SMD_HEDGERATIO_PCT_B' as LIMIT_NAME,
	case
		when subtruct_fcp = 'Y' then coalesce(abs((short_hedge_pv - fcp_base_pv) / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
		when subtruct_fcp = 'N' then coalesce(abs(short_hedge_pv / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
	end as MEASURE_VALUE
  from hedge_ratio_short_long a

/* cppi::0de292b3db9e245a4a3f69d237cf698a7ff3a90164174482d739d49b92789482 */
SELECT distinct
         case 
            when constituents.id_cppib_index = '23059_TR_USD_0_0' then  'LG50TRUU Index' 
            when constituents.id_cppib_index = 'CEMBIB_TR_USD_0_0' then  'CEMBI_BROAD_XRCON_PC' 
            when constituents.id_cppib_index = '9805_TR_USD_0_0' then  'LGCPTRUU Index'
            when constituents.id_cppib_index = '35156_TR_USD_0_0' then 'H35156US Index' 
         end as index_name           
    , constituents.business_date as pricedate
    , constituents.id_cppib_security as id_cppib_security
    , case when constituents.id_isin_eod = '' then constituents.id_isin_ndo else constituents.id_isin_eod end as isin
    , constituents.security_name as security_name
    , constituents.id_ticker_eod as ticker
    , constituents.classification_code_1_description as bclass_code_1
    , constituents.classification_code_2_description as bclass_code_2
    , constituents.classification_code_3_description as bclass_code_3
    , constituents.classification_code_4_description as bclass_code_4
    , constituents.trading_to_flag as trading_to_flag
    , constituents.subordinate_type as subordinate_type
    , constituents.country_reference_code_eod as country_code
    , constituents.product_currency as product_currency
    , constituents.iso_currency_eod as iso_currency
    , constituents.issuer_name as issuer
    , case when constituents.rating = '' or constituents.rating is null or constituents.rating = '0' then 'NR' else constituents.rating end as rating_moodys
    , case when constituents.rating_sp = '' or constituents.rating_sp is  null or constituents.rating_sp = '0' then 'NR' else constituents.rating_sp end as rating_sp
    , case when constituents.rating_fitch = '' or constituents.rating_fitch is null or constituents.rating_fitch = '0' then 'NR' else constituents.rating_fitch  end as rating_fitch
    , constituents.maturity_date as maturity_date
    ,  case 
            when constituents.id_cppib_index = 'CEMBIB_TR_USD_0_0' then  constituents.spread_duration
            else constituents.modified_duration 
            end as modified_duration
    , constituents.modified_duration_to_worst as modified_duration_to_worst
    , constituents.call_flag as call_flag
    , constituents.convexity as convexity
    , constituents.coupon as coupon
    , constituents.coupon_frequency as coupon_frequency
    , constituents.accrued_interest as accrued_interest
    , constituents.notional_value_outstanding as notional_value_outstanding
    , constituents.fx_rate as fx_rate
    , constituents.coupon_return_daily_local as coupon_return_daily_local
    , constituents.currency_return_daily_local as currency_return_daily_local
    , constituents.price_return_daily_local as price_return_daily_local
    , constituents.return_daily_local as return_daily_local
    , constituents.par_amount_local as par_amount_local
    , constituents.par_amount_usd as par_amount_usd
    , constituents.bid_spread as bid_spread
    , case when constituents.id_cppib_index = 'CEMBIB_TR_USD_0_0' then constituents.blended_spread
    else constituents.oas end as oas
    , constituents.oas_to_swap as oas_to_swap
    , constituents.oas_to_worse as oas_to_worse
    , constituents.last_value_eod as last_price
    , constituents.yield_to_worst as yield_to_worst,
    CASE
        WHEN class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 IS NULL
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 = ''
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 = '0' THEN 'Undefined'
        ELSE class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1
    END AS gics_sector,
    CASE
        WHEN class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 IS NULL
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 = ''
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 = '0' THEN 'Undefined'
        ELSE class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2
    END AS gics_industry_group,
    CASE
        WHEN class.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 IS NULL
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 = ''
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 = '0' THEN 'Undefined'
        ELSE class.cppib_sector_classification_name_3
    END AS gics_industry,
    CASE
        WHEN class.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 IS NULL
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 = ''
        OR class.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 = '0' THEN 'Undefined'
        ELSE class.cppib_sector_classification_name_4
    END AS gics_sub_industry
    , constituents.full_market_capitalization_base_eod as market_value
    , constituents.weight_eod as weight
    , constituents.adjusted_modified_duration as rates_duration
    , case 
            when constituents.id_cppib_index = 'CEMBIB_TR_USD_0_0' then  constituents.spread_duration
            else constituents.modified_duration 
            end as credit_duration
    , constituents.dated_date as issue_date
    , ab.next_call_date as next_call_date
    , constituents.maturity_date as workout_date
    , pt.party_name as parent_issuer
    FROM market.cppib_index_constituent constituents
    left join asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications class ON constituents.id_cppib_security = class.cppib_sec_id AND constituents.business_date = class.business_date

"Gross Purchase PC" END AS "Fixed Gross Purchase PC", CASE WHEN "Net Sell PC" > 0 THEN "Net Sell PC" ELSE 0 END AS "Fixed Net Sell PC"
FROM (WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND model_portfolio IN (
				'RIPREI1A','RIPREI2A','RIPREI1E','RIPREI2E',								-- Listed RE
				'MPINFRA1D','MPINFRA2D','MPINFRA1E','MPINLCP1D',							-- Listed Infra
				'MPSEG1D','MPSEG1E',														-- Listed SEG
				'MIN1000104','MINELET','MINEON9','MINADP9','MINDNY9','MINCLNX',				-- Public Holidings in Private Infra
				'MPAR100040','MPAR100041','MPAR100043','MPAR100053','MPR1000200','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPAREDP','MPARELE','MPRSBE0'	-- Public Holidings in Private SEG
              )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    )

	WHERE

	GROUP BY

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 08:28:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 12:41:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case

		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *

					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2

	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name as combined_entity_name_original
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name_clean as combined_entity_name_clean
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(swap|leg|bond|repo)\b.*') then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT "party_name", "cppib_party_id", "cppib_party_id_str", "parent_cppib_party_id", "ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id", "bloomberg_company_id", "incorp_country_code", "legal_entity_name", "cppib_country_of_exposure_code", "cppib_sector_classification_name_1", "cppib_sector_classification_name_2", "cppib_sector_classification_name_3", "cppib_sector_classification_name_4", "cppib_party_tree_id", "entity_tree_order", "entity_tree_level", "has_securities_flag", "has_children"
FROM (SELECT
    COALESCE(eu."party_name", '') AS "party_name",
    eu."cppib_party_id" AS "cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "cppib_party_id_str",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."parent_cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "parent_cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(eu."bloomberg_company_id", '') AS "bloomberg_company_id",
    COALESCE(eu."incorp_country_code", '') AS "incorp_country_code",
    COALESCE(eu."legal_entity_name", '') AS "legal_entity_name",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_country_of_exposure_code", '') AS "cppib_country_of_exposure_code",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_1", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_1",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_2", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_2",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_3", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_3",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_4", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_4",
    etu."cppib_party_tree_id" AS "cppib_party_tree_id",
    etu."entity_tree_order" AS "entity_tree_order",
    etu.entity_tree_level AS "entity_tree_level",
    CASE
        WHEN eu."has_securities" = 1 THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS "has_securities_flag",
    COALESCE(child_flags.has_children, 'No') AS has_children
FROM legal_dc_prod.entities_universe eu

LEFT JOIN legal_dc_prod.entities_tree_universe etu
    ON eu."cppib_party_id" = etu."cppib_party_id"

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent_cppib_party_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS has_children
    FROM legal_dc_prod.entities_universe
    GROUP BY parent_cppib_party_id
) AS child_flags
    ON eu.cppib_party_id = child_flags.parent_cppib_party_id

ORDER BY etu."entity_tree_order" ASC
) AS "parent_entities_universe"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 18 and 19
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 18:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::3a44037d39b1acb10f9906998e4e26e2ee499bff71f1eee65042f60dd58e35b6 */
SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','VEB','ZWG')
								AND erc.data_date BETWEEN to_date('2008-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND to_date('2025-06-04', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND (erd.exchange_rate is not NULL OR erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag = 1)
						)
					)
			    )
        WHERE currencyToUsdRate is not NULL

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','VEB','ZWG')

			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null

			and value is not null

			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"
LIMIT 1000
